rationale: The Init function modifies the global variable `time.Local` (a package-level variable in the time package) via `time.LoadLocation` and assignment. This global state modification occurs within a transaction entrypoint and affects how time operations behave across the process. While the immediate Init writes use array iteration (deterministic), modifying global state in chaincode is a consensus-critical issue as different peers may have different timezone database states, causing `time.LoadLocation` to fail on some peers but succeed on others, leading to endorsement divergence.
